facts.summary: Stock fell despite positive data; SUMMIT/APEX results presented at ASH · Phase 2 · bezuclastinib in systemic mastocytosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: announced positive initial data from the Company's ongoing Phase 2 SUMMIT clinical trial evaluating bezuclastinib in patients with nonadvanced systemic mastocytosis
evidence.safety: Related serious adverse events were reported in four patients including Grade 4 thrombocytopenia, Grade 3 hypersensitivity (mediator flare), Grade 3 leishmaniasis, and Grade 3 drug induced liver injury
